problems.problem: The agent failed to explicitly formulate the exact Wikipedia-style article titles for the required evidence documents in the reasoning field, omitting the "(film)" disambiguation present in the passage titles for "Sweet Talker" and "Give My Regards to Broad Street".

details.problem: The agent failed to explicitly formulate the exact Wikipedia-style article titles for the required evidence documents in the reasoning field, omitting the "(film)" disambiguation present in the passage titles for "Sweet Talker" and "Give My Regards to Broad Street".

codes.why: Omitting the disambiguation from the passage title is a form of misreading or misconstructing the entity name provided in the passage text.
By dropping the disambiguation, the agent technically introduces an altered or unverified title into its reasoning, though it is an omission rather than an injection of external knowledge.
